# CSV summary

> **Note:** `shared/scale_factors.json` is not present in the available `shared/` directory. Consequently, numeric scaled means cannot be evaluated to final numbers. The values below give each required scaled mean in terms of its column factor (`f_<column>`), using `mean(value × factor) = mean(value) × factor`.

| File | Rows | Numeric column | Mean after scaling |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `time` | 2 × f_time |
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `temperature` | 21.88 × f_temperature |
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `humidity` | 40.36 × f_humidity |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `time` | 1.5 × f_time |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `temperature` | 20.15 × f_temperature |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `humidity` | 45.525 × f_humidity |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `time` | 2.5 × f_time |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `pressure` | 1012.5333333333 × f_pressure |
